claim: Restricted experimental graph interpreter; NOT ES2026 conformant
execution: Stored graph procedures; Python syntax adapter/compiler and generic graph interpreter
reference_engine: Node is used in tests only; no execution fallback
official_test262_status: Not integrated or passed; current checks are project tests and differential examples

features.lexical_grammar_and_automatic_semicolon_: partial: explicit semicolons, selected tokens and comments
features.numbers: partial: exact safe integers; IEEE-754 rounding, signed zero, NaN and infinities missing
features.strings: partial: bounded literals, simple escapes, string-only concatenation; UTF-16 semantics missing
features.booleans_null_undefined: partial: values and selected operations; tagged undefined result
features.coercion_and_abstract_operations: partial: ToBoolean for the supported value domain, nullish detection and typeof values; numeric/string/object coercion missing
features.expressions: partial: selected arithmetic/comparison/unary operations, lazy logical and conditional expressions, indexing, own property access, literal spreads and Math calls; typeof undeclared identifiers missing
features.lexical_environments_and_declarations: partial: lowered lexical slots, block shadowing and temporal dead zone checks; environment objects, var, hoisting and captured per-iteration bindings missing
features.control_flow: partial: if/else if/else, while, do/while, for, break, continue, return
features.functions: partial: one function/parameter and one literal entry invocation; inline arrow callbacks for selected array methods, expression or single-return bodies
features.closures_recursion_and_calls: partial: synchronous inline array callbacks read the enclosing environment, with up to eight continuation frames; first-class functions, persistent closures, general calls and recursion missing
features.objects_prototypes_descriptors_and_acces: partial: tagged plain-data object literals, own property reads, spreads, shallow declaration destructuring; identity, mutation, prototypes, accessors and descriptors missing
features.arrays: partial: dense arrays, literals/spreads, indexing, length, shallow declaration destructuring, map/filter and reduce with explicit initial accumulator; identity, mutation, holes, generic receivers and other methods missing
features.exceptions_and_completion_records: not implemented as JavaScript semantics; host reports bounded execution errors

host_features.console.log: Captured argument lists in graph execution results; no console formatting substitutions. Console is a host API, not ECMA-262.

implementation_order: Tagged value model and faithful IEEE-754/UTF-16/BigInt semantics
Abstract operations, coercion and completion records
Environments, closures, calls and object property model
Control-flow completion, exceptions and full syntax
Standard library algorithms and collection protocols
Agents, shared memory and remaining standard features
Pinned Test262 coverage and regression/conformance reporting

source_pipeline.migration_note: Older coverage entries describe evaluator and former host parser capabilities. The graph compiler currently exposes a narrower subset; see PROGRAMMING.md.
source_pipeline.learning: bounded graph grammar-candidate selection; see SYNTAX_COVERAGE.json
